description: Craft, tailor, and polish modern ATS-friendly resumes with multi-provider AI assistance. Supports OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq, and local Ollama models. Stores API keys securely using Web Crypto AES-GCM and Appshell secrets. Export directly to print-ready PDF, HTML, or structured JSON.
tagline: Build professional, AI-tailored resumes with multi-model freedom.
highlights: Multi-LLM: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Ollama
Instant print-ready PDF and JSON export
whatsNew: Initial release with multi-LLM support and secure credential storage.
